[{"name": "local_time_pop", "idea": "Popularity of the candidate at the moment of the session: distinct other target-week prefixes that touch or buy the item within 3 hours of the session's last event, plus that local count relative to the item's whole-week prefixes, to catch flash trends and time-of-day demand that weekly counts average out.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH m AS (SELECT s.session, max((s.ts - {S}) // 3600) AS b FROM sess s JOIN sessions x ON s.session = x.session GROUP BY s.session), ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), bk AS (SELECT s.item, (s.ts - {S}) // 3600 AS b, count(DISTINCT s.session) AS n, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.event IN ('cart', 'order') THEN s.session END) AS nb FROM sess s JOIN ci ON s.item = ci.item GROUP BY s.item, (s.ts - {S}) // 3600), wk AS (SELECT s.item, count(DISTINCT s.session) AS w FROM sess s JOIN ci ON s.item = ci.item GROUP BY s.item), ow AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, (s.ts - {S}) // 3600 AS b, max(CASE WHEN s.event IN ('cart', 'order') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ob FROM sess s JOIN sessions x ON s.session = x.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item, (s.ts - {S}) // 3600), lp AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(bk.n) AS n, sum(bk.nb) AS nb FROM cand c JOIN m ON m.session = c.session JOIN bk ON bk.item = c.item AND bk.b BETWEEN m.b - 3 AND m.b + 3 GROUP BY c.session, c.item), oc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, count(*) AS n, sum(ow.ob) AS nb FROM cand c JOIN m ON m.session = c.session JOIN ow ON ow.session = c.session AND ow.item = c.item AND ow.b BETWEEN m.b - 3 AND m.b + 3 GROUP BY c.session, c.item) SELECT lp.session, lp.item, CAST(lp.n - coalesce(oc.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_lt_sess, CAST(lp.nb - coalesce(oc.nb, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_lt_buy, CAST((lp.n - coalesce(oc.n, 0) + 1.0) / (wk.w + 24.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_lt_share FROM lp JOIN wk ON wk.item = lp.item LEFT JOIN oc ON oc.session = lp.session AND oc.item = lp.item;"},
{"name": "p_self_trans", "idea": "Within-session transitions involving the last prefix item: how often the candidate directly followed the last item earlier in this prefix and how often it directly preceded it, capturing back-and-forth comparison between two items that predicts the next view.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.seq, lag(s.item) OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq, s.item) AS pi, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item DESC) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions x ON s.session = x.session), li AS (SELECT session, item AS li FROM e WHERE rk = 1), fa AS (SELECT e.session, e.item, count(*) AS n FROM e JOIN li ON li.session = e.session WHERE e.pi = li.li AND e.item <> li.li GROUP BY e.session, e.item), tb AS (SELECT e.session, e.pi AS item, count(*) AS n FROM e JOIN li ON li.session = e.session WHERE e.item = li.li AND e.pi <> li.li AND e.rk > 1 GROUP BY e.session, e.pi), u AS (SELECT session, item FROM fa UNION SELECT session, item FROM tb) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(coalesce(fa.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_after_last, CAST(coalesce(tb.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_before_last FROM cand c JOIN u ON u.session = c.session AND u.item = c.item LEFT JOIN fa ON fa.session = c.session AND fa.item = c.item LEFT JOIN tb ON tb.session = c.session AND tb.item = c.item;"},
{"name": "nv_backward", "idea": "Reverse history next-view strength: how strongly the candidate leads into the session's last 3 distinct prefix items (weighted 3/2/1), which identifies substitutes and alternatives of the browsed items that forward transitions miss.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), lr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM l), lt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM lr WHERE r <= 3), sc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(CAST(round(t.tv_wgt * 6) AS BIGINT) * (4 - lt.r)) AS v FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session AND lt.item <> c.item JOIN tb_nextview t ON t.item = c.item AND t.item2 = lt.item GROUP BY c.session, c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_nvb_score FROM sc WHERE v > 0;"},
{"name": "wk_cocart", "idea": "In-week cart-to-cart affinity: for the session's last 5 carted or ordered prefix items, the share of other recent target-week prefixes buying those items that also carted or ordered the candidate (own prefix removed), recency weighted, aimed at cart and order completion.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH bt AS (SELECT session, item, max(ts) AS mt, max(seq) AS ls FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), lr AS (SELECT bt.session, bt.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bt.session ORDER BY bt.ls DESC, bt.item) AS r FROM bt JOIN sessions b ON b.session = bt.session), lt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM lr WHERE r <= 5), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT bt.session, bt.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bt.item ORDER BY bt.mt DESC, bt.session) AS rn FROM bt JOIN it ON bt.item = it.item) z WHERE rn <= 1000), nn AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM ps GROUP BY item), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, b.item AS item2, count(*) AS nb FROM ps p JOIN bt b ON b.session = p.session AND b.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, b.item), z0 AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, lt.r, nn.n, nx.nb - CASE WHEN ob.item IS NOT NULL AND op.item IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nb FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session AND lt.item <> c.item JOIN nx ON nx.item = lt.item AND nx.item2 = c.item JOIN nn ON nn.item = lt.item LEFT JOIN bt ob ON ob.session = c.session AND ob.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ps op ON op.session = c.session AND op.item = lt.item), sc AS (SELECT session, item, sum((nb * 100000) // (n + 5) * (6 - r)) AS v FROM z0 WHERE nb > 0 GROUP BY session, item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wcc_share FROM sc WHERE v > 0;"},
{"name": "wk_coview_last", "idea": "In-week whole-prefix co-visitation from the very last prefix item: the share of the 300 most recent other target-week prefixes containing it that also contain the candidate (own prefix removed), covering base and history candidates beyond 1-3 step transitions.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), lt AS (SELECT session, item FROM l WHERE rk = 1), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), ps0 AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.ts) AS mt FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item GROUP BY s.session, s.item), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY mt DESC, session) AS rn FROM ps0) z WHERE rn <= 300), nn AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM ps GROUP BY item), si AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.session, s.item FROM sess s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT session FROM ps) q ON q.session = s.session), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, y.item AS item2, count(*) AS nb FROM ps p JOIN si y ON y.session = p.session AND y.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, y.item), oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.session, s.item FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), z0 AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, nn.n, nx.nb - CASE WHEN op.item IS NOT NULL AND oc.item IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nb FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session AND lt.item <> c.item JOIN nx ON nx.item = lt.item AND nx.item2 = c.item JOIN nn ON nn.item = lt.item LEFT JOIN ps op ON op.session = c.session AND op.item = lt.item LEFT JOIN oc ON oc.session = c.session AND oc.item = c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST((nb + 0.0) / (n + 5) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wcv_share FROM z0 WHERE nb > 0;"}]
